objective: Deliver a usable local conversation and calculate/convert tool-call model derived exclusively from our random-initialized base. Preserve existing acceptance criteria.

authorization.gcp: Authorized by user as needed; any zone; one GPU at a time.

starting_point.proven: Bounded CUDA math/update path and GCS restart.
starting_point.not_proven: Conversation, transferable context binding, tool correctness, sustained training throughput or full crash recovery at every boundary.

corrections.action: Keep 6e-5 for the controlled pilot with identical optimizer state/batch. Later use a predeclared modest cosine decay, not another open-ended LR sweep.

corrections.problem: Perfect memorization with poor transfer; previous template split also changed entities.
corrections.action: Create crossed entity/template holdouts, diverse labels, 2-6 entities, varied query positions, distractors, corrections and explicit counterfactuals. Separate training, development and final acceptance.

Keep 512 for the matched data pilot; then introduce 1024-token complete sequences. Rebenchmark with microbatch8 and effective8192 positions. Test evidence near beginning/middle/end and at 128/256/512/768+ token distances. Never advertise a length that fails.

corrections.problem: Repeated training on a small corpus can resemble progress.
corrections.action: Report unique documents/tokens, replay exposure and per-source loss. Reuse admitted narrative/explanatory data transparently. Before a long run, audit enough new source material; never relabel replay as fresh.
Measure sustained throughput including evaluation, checkpoint upload and startup. Token targets are ceilings; provider lease/cost wins.

corrections.problem: Repetition penalty can hide weak semantics.
corrections.action: Assess raw greedy generations plus a separately fixed serving decoder. Compare penalty1.0 versus existing1.3 on development only; exclude structural/call tokens or retain penalty1.0 for calls. Freeze chosen decoding before acceptance. Do not add an untested training penalty in the data comparison.

corrections.problem: Template-heavy SFT and host repairs can conceal model failures.
corrections.action: Use assistant-only loss on actual serialized chat, EOT and tool frames; replay tools and verify arguments/results. Count raw model proposals separately from host rejections. No regex answer repair or pretrained fallback.

stages.name: Prepare corrected data and assessments
work: Validate current input and checkpoint hashes; preserve parent and acceptance freeze.
Build crossed context development suite and varied training examples; inspect samples, deduplicate by entity/template families and preserve source identity.
Audit existing admitted narrative/explanatory slices and remaining unused broad rows. Freeze source proportions and sample order before training.
Build end-to-end restart/crash tests for the new runner, including data cursor, LR scheduler, loss masks and sequence length.
Prepare larger diverse text intake locally while GPU is off; do not block on needless corpus re-downloads.
stages.gate: Verified manifests, frozen assessments, no train/held-out overlap, exact resume equivalence for new path; input package fully in GCS before provisioning.

stages.name: Equal-budget data comparison

settings.objective: Full next-token CE for both arms; context examples include answers and EOT. Mask padding; log actual supervised targets. Do not confound mixture with answer-only loss.
settings.start: Same protected parent and optimizer for both arms, sequential runs.

stages.assessment: Baseline, half-way light evaluation, endpoint full development. Paired held-out losses on fixed broad/narrative/explanatory windows; crossed context splits; original32 pairs; at least64 new prose prompts.
stages.gate: Mixture beats control on held-out mixture CE and context exactness by at least10 percentage points in both unseen-entity and unseen-template splits; broad CE regression <=0.05; no worse repetition. These are prospective engineering go/no-go thresholds, not statistical proof. If CE improves but context gate fails, allow at most one bounded supervised context pilot using contingency; do not start a long run automatically.

stages.name: Budgeted base continuation with context-length correction
stages.conditional_on: Stage B passes, sufficient admitted data and remaining budget.
work: Use the chosen mixture; keep124M architecture and current tokenizer. Report before starting this longer phase.
Introduce1024-token examples after a successful short parity/memory benchmark; effective8192positions, microbatch adjusted for memory.
Freeze learning schedule before start: peak6e-5, cosine to2e-5 over the allocated target budget, preserved optimizer; warm transition if needed and report it.
Checkpoint and evaluate every50Mtargets or30minutes, whichever comes first; retain latest plus best and protected parent. Full checkpoint backup at least every15minutes.
stages.stop: Nonfinite loss, resource/recovery failure, cost lease, broadCE degradation >0.10 at two assessments, or two successive milestones without development improvement. Do not consume remaining credit by default.
stages.gate: At least80% exact context answers in each crossed development split and70% fully-correct counterfactual pairs; at least75% coherent/relevant completions on64 frozen new prompts; repetitive collapse <=10%. If not met, retain evidence and stop scaling.

stages.name: Conversation and real tool SFT
stages.conditional_on: Stage C language/context gate passes, or a clearly documented shorter successful candidate.
work: Use admitted public short conversation sources first; evaluate smol-smoltalk for additional short-form diversity only after provenance, license, leakage and quality review.
Use own-base exact chat framing and assistant-only loss including complete call JSON and EOT; tools calculate/convert are executed by the existing broker.
Never train assistant to invent tool observations. Include rejected requests, missing operands, ordered subtraction, dependent calls, incompatible units and result corrections.
One short overfit check of representative serialized sessions before full SFT. Start separate SFT optimizer explicitly; screen3e-5 on short dev pilot, with at most one1e-5 retry if forgetting.
At most2passes per admitted session; evaluate by held-out template/intent/session rather than random turns.
stages.gate: Development full-session success>=80%, valid tool JSON>=98%, correct tool/arguments>=95%, grounded returned answers>=95%, zero unauthorized/incorrect executed calls. Conversation subset also>=80%; averages cannot hide failed categories.

stages.name: Independent acceptance and local serving
work: Freeze weights, tokenizer, framing, decoder and broker version before final evaluation.
Run existing practical-usability20sessions/62turns unchanged: >=16complete sessions; all16expected executions correct; zero incorrect/unauthorized executions.
Use separate original sealed acceptance if its prior release contract still applies; never tune on failed final cases.
Serve only passed candidate locally through existing own-base chat; show raw model outputs and actual broker records. Benchmark Mac latency/memory and replay representative chat/tool sessions there.
Publish checkpoint hash, source lineage, known limitations, cost ledger and reproducible run command; retain prior model for rollback.
stages.failure: Do not label as working. Preserve failed report; correction uses new development cases and a newly frozen confirmation set, within remaining budget.

rules: Reserve worst-case VM lease before provisioning; reservations, not billing alerts, enforce cap.
Reconcile completed leases from provider timestamps; no credit balance assumption.
One active VM, any zone, no parallel weights writes. Prefer on-demand A100 for this short budget; do not introduce spot recovery risk without a measured benefit.
No additional paid APIs or model-generation services authorized by this plan.
No GPU idle during local data preparation. Stop/delete VM and auto-delete disk at every phase boundary; provider max runtime and guest shutdown both required.

backup: Code archive hash and pinned machine image
Weights, FP32 optimizer, RNG, LR state and step
Evaluation results, raw outputs, tool traces and server logs
requirements: Roundtrip checksum and resume-update equality before each new training path.
Recovery artifacts verified before GPU deletion; original parent never overwritten.
No arbitrary full-machine image required; pinned image+code+inputs+checkpoint reconstruct server.

eta.first_corrected_pilot_verdict: 2-4 hours after preparation begins, assuming source receipts remain valid and A100 capacity is available.
eta.complete_budgeted_attempt: 8-16 hours for the current $50-limited tranche and assessments, not for the full10B campaign; no working-model guarantee.
eta.usable_model: No defensible guaranteed ETA until context/language gates pass. $50 may be insufficient; stop and report rather than quietly exceed it.

scale_decision: Do not move to360M/1B yet. Larger models reduce affordable token exposure. Revisit capacity only after transferable learning and a measured remaining-budget estimate; do not silently spend on a new architecture.

research_basis.use: Small-model SFT uses smol-smoltalk; informs short diverse conversation data, not pretrained weights or a performance guarantee.
End-to-end pretraining/SFT/evaluation separation and measured systems throughput; headline cost is not transferable to this A100 run.
Data-centric small-model training; our tiny compute budget is not comparable to published training scale.

execution_status: Plan and local readiness preparation only at publication; no new GPU or long run launched.

overall_campaign.interpretation: 10B training tokens, not 10B parameters. User confirmed target.
overall_campaign.current_budgeted_tranche: The <=400M continuation ceiling is a first budget-limited tranche, not a replacement for the 10B campaign.
overall_campaign.budget_boundary: Current $50 approval cannot fund the full10B campaign at measured throughput. Prepare curriculum and durable continuation to10B; execute only funded gated tranches. Explicit approval required before total project expense exceeds$50.
overall_campaign.estimate_limit: Short512-token benchmark; sustained1024-token training, evaluation and backups will take longer. $6/hour is our conservative reservation rate, not a quoted GCP tariff.
